candidate.answerReason: Tennis must be Tuesday or Thursday. Tuesday would leave only four consecutive days for three nonconsecutive runs, which is impossible. Thursday tennis forces runs on Tuesday, Friday, and Sunday, leaving Saturday for swimming.

methods.label: Determine tennis before placing the runs
methods.explanation:
The three running days, together with one day each for basketball, golf, swimming, and tennis, fill all seven days. Basketball is Monday and golf is Wednesday.

Tennis cannot follow running or swimming, and there is only one tennis day. It must therefore follow basketball or golf, so tennis is either Tuesday or Thursday.

If tennis were Tuesday, all three runs would have to fit into Thursday through Sunday. At most one run can occur in the Thursday-Friday pair, and at most one in the Saturday-Sunday pair. Thus these four days can contain at most two runs, so Tuesday tennis is impossible.

Tennis is therefore Thursday. The three runs must now occupy three of Tuesday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. At most two of the three consecutive days Friday through Sunday can be running days, so Tuesday must be a running day. To choose two nonconsecutive running days from Friday through Sunday, they must be Friday and Sunday. This leaves Saturday for swimming.

The runs on Tuesday, Friday, and Sunday are nonconsecutive, and Thursday tennis follows Wednesday golf, so the schedule satisfies all the restrictions. Marley swims on \(\boxed{\text{Saturday}}\), choice E.
